assumptions.reason: Per-unit pricing is the most common real-time charging model.
SUM is the default aggregation for usage quantity fields.

blockers.message: REALTIME_CHARGING groupFields is required. Which fields define the charging groups? (e.g. ["accountNumber", "subscriptionNumber"])
REALTIME_CHARGING usageQuantityField is required. Which event field contains the usage quantity to charge?
REALTIME_CHARGING unitPrice is required when priceModel is PerUnit. What is the price per unit?
REALTIME_CHARGING priceTable is required when priceModel is Tiered. Provide the tiered pricing rules.
